home.faq_icao_q: What is the ICAO code for {name}?
home.faq_arrive_q: How early should I arrive at {name}?
home.faq_arrive_a: For international flights, arrive at least 3 hours before departure; for domestic flights, about 2 hours.
home.faq_missing_q: {iata}: why is my flight missing from the board?
home.faq_missing_a: Check the airport, the Departures or Arrivals tab and the flight’s local date. Select All in the status filter. Enter the flight number with or without spaces. Search only checks flights in the loaded board; if the flight is not found, clear the search. A missing flight does not mean it is cancelled: check how recent the data is and confirm its status with the airline.
home.faq_tomorrow_a: The board shows flights from the latest data snapshot, rather than a complete schedule for any date. The flight card shows the local date. If tomorrow’s flight is not listed yet, check the schedule with the airline; the board’s update time does not guarantee that all of tomorrow’s flights are included.
home.faq_terminal_q: {iata}: where can I find the terminal and gate?
home.faq_terminal_a: Open the flight card. The terminal and gate are shown when they are included in the data received. An empty field does not mean that no terminal has been assigned. Check with the airline before travelling and with the airport’s own boards once you arrive.
home.faq_live_q: How can I see live flights at {name}?
home.faq_live_a: Choose departures or arrivals on the {name} ({iata}) board. Times are local, and the board shows how old the data is. When you open the page, the site requests an update if the data is 10 minutes old or more. If the update is delayed, the last saved snapshot remains visible — check its age.
home.footer_tagline: Live airport boards for {served, number} airports with scheduled passenger service. Arrivals and departures, with the age of the data on every board.

home.widgets_meta: Free arrivals and departures board for your website. Embed an iframe showing the latest received snapshot and its age, with automatic page reloads.
home.widgets_intro: Choose an airport, copy the code and paste it into a page that allows iframes. The widget shows departures or arrivals from the latest received snapshot and the age of that data. The widget page reloads automatically; this does not guarantee new data. It says when data is unavailable. Free if you keep the link below the widget.
home.widgets_note: Free if you keep the link below the widget. Your website must allow iframe embedding.

home.faq_meeting_q: When will the passenger leave arrivals at {iata}?
home.faq_meeting_a: The “Landed” status refers to the aircraft, not to the passenger leaving the arrivals area. Baggage collection and passport control may take additional time. The board does not show when a passenger will come out.
